text:
Sam (Partnerships): Quick sync thread to finalize partner GTM surge windows + cutover play for the marketplace listing day. We need: confirmed embargo time, staggered partner social times, HW partner listing checklist (EdgeWorks certs), SI integration smoke checklist, and an on-call plan for first 6 hours post-launch.
Lina (Marketing): Proposed embargo lift: 2026-05-05 18:00 PT (01:00 UTC next day). Rationale: gives EU morning and APAC afternoon next day. But if HW partner (EdgeWorks) needs APAC morning, we can shift. Thoughts? :globe_with_meridians:
Rahul (Platform): For cutover we can do canary -> full promote. Need 90m window to run DB migrations and index rebuilds at low traffic. Canary to 5% for 20m, then ramp to 50% for 15m, then full. CDN invalidation is time-consuming; schedule edge purge after full promote.
Diego (Eng): Canary path ok. We'll enable verbose traces during canary. Request: a short maintenance banner (10m) ahead of the canary switch. Also, EdgeWorks tile relies on feature flag "edgeworks_tile_v2"; ensure it's off until post-toggle.
Mei (Legal): Embargo copy is fine, but hardware partners require trademark approvals for logos—EdgeWorks needs explicit sign-off; SI-Plus asked for a redline on their quote. We need signed approvals back 48h before embargo.
Sam (Partnerships): Key partners we plan to include in primary press: EdgeWorks (HW), CloudCloud (public cloud listing), SI-Plus (systems integrator). Lina please confirm quote owners and who will post partner blogs.
Lina (Marketing): I'll own CloudCloud and SI-Plus blogs. Need partner blog publish windows: propose T+4h for CloudCloud, T+8h for SI-Plus, T+12h for EdgeWorks (EdgeWorks request later APAC slot). Keeps headlines spaced.
OncallBot: Reminder: schedule oncall rotation for launch day. Add pager duty schedule to thread.
Rahul (Platform): Runbook excerpt (short):
```
# canary promote
precheck: run db-sanity.sh
deploy: apply marketplace-canary.yaml
wait: healthcheck 5m
if healthy -> scale to 50% -> wait 15m
promote: switch nginx upstream -> full
post: purge-cdn --zone=global --paths="/marketplace/*"
monitor: 3600s
rollback: revert nginx upstream to blue
```
Diego (Eng): Adding a fallback route to read-only cache for 30m after promote to mitigate any indexing lag. Also will keep debug logging for 2h.
Sam (Partnerships): APAC constraints: EdgeWorks legal needs translations for quote in JP and KR before publish. Mei, can legal expedite?
Mei (Legal): We can do translations but need the canonical English quote by EOD Tue. We'll coordinate with partner legal.
Lina (Marketing): Social cadence: we'll stagger partner social posts by region: US (T+4h), EU (T+6h), APAC (T+12h). Partners ok with stagger?
EdgeWorks (via Sam): EdgeWorks requests that their product badge appears in the first viewport and that their PR contact is listed. Also asked for a short video embed slot; engineering note: video must be lazy-loaded.
Diego (Eng): Can add lazy-load video; recommend loading via CDN with low-priority hint. We'll need the video asset before T-24h.
Sam (Partnerships): Action items captured: Lina - confirm partner quote owners & blog authors and collect English quotes by EOD Tue; Mei - legal translations & trademark signoff; Rahul - finalize runbook + CDN purge timing; Diego - ensure feature flag gating and video lazy-load; Sam - deliver partner asset packet to partners T-72h.
Lina (Marketing): I'll send a partner asset ZIP with logo specs, social copy templates, and embargo PDF. Targeting T-72h as requested.
Rahul (Platform): One more ops note: DNS TTL set to 60s for the cutover window to minimize propagation lag. Revert to 300s 24h after launch.
Diego (Eng): We should also enable circuit-breaker for partner tiles: if tile errors > 5% for 5m, hide tile and surface partner contact link. I'll add to runtime config.
Mei (Legal): I'll track signoffs in a shared doc and post link here once available.
Sam (Partnerships): Optional quick call at 09:00 PT to iron out the staggered publish times? Ping :bell: if you can make it.
Lina (Marketing): I can do 09:00 PT. Adding to calendar.
OncallBot: Note: post-launch SLO monitors will alert on 5xx spike, latency > 800ms, and error budget burn. Ensure Dashboards ready.
Sam (Partnerships): Great progress — will update partners after Lina confirms owners. Thanks all.
